case: Legacy datetime text and typed tick no-op edits through the app grid parser
contract: The app grid formatter displays text fallback values verbatim and preserves the nonzero fractional seconds of typed DateTime values.
The parser reads the displayed SQL Server legacy datetime value, the keyed-update builder targets the row by its primary key, and bound updates leave native varbinary(8) values unchanged.

Coverage includes a 1/300-second tick rendered as .003 text, a 2/300-second tick rendered as .007 text, an exact .010 typed tick, and an untouched sibling row. All rows and native bytes are identical before and after the no-op edits.

native_app_grid_contract.result: 1 passed; SQL Server native bytes and sibling row preserved

remaining: This representative app-grid contract does not cover every temporal precision, timezone/session configuration, spreadsheet format or installed GTK workflow.
This case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
